object_qoi_context.object: The exact C002 natural-order Abel boundary-plus-tail remainder after replacing Bellotti's unexposed PNT constants by a separately sourced explicit Chebyshev-psi error theorem.
object_qoi_context.quantity_of_interest: Whether an authoritative source exposes a numerical normalized PNT constant and validity threshold sufficient to define an explicit candidate-family envelope without yet selecting or evaluating a mathematical candidate.
object_qoi_context.scope: Source assimilation and pre-candidate routing only for fixed n and the exact endpoint remainder.

exact_anchors: Table 1, arXiv PDF page 3, row X=log 2
primary_source.exact_statement: For every real x>=2, |psi(x)-x| <= 9.39 x (log x)^1.515 exp(-0.8274 sqrt(log x)).
primary_source.normalized_statement: For every real x>=2, |psi(x)-x|/x <= 9.39 (log x)^1.515 exp(-0.8274 sqrt(log x)).
primary_source.publication: Journal of Mathematical Analysis and Applications 527(2) (2023), article 127460
primary_source.title: Some explicit estimates for the error term in the prime number theorem

preferred_direct_jy_family.integral_identity: For j>=0 and u>=0, integral_u^infinity s^(j+a) exp(-c sqrt(s)) ds = 2 c^(-2j-2a-2) Gamma(2j+2a+2,c sqrt(u)); with a=1.515 this is 2 c^(-2j-5.03) Gamma(2j+5.03,c sqrt(u)).
preferred_direct_jy_family.monotonicity_floor_proposal: U_JY(n)=max(log 2,n-1,[2(n-1+1.515)/0.8274]^2). Beyond U_JY every boundary monomial is nonincreasing and every upper incomplete-gamma tail decreases.
preferred_direct_jy_family.symbolic_modulus_family_only: After a future candidate freeze and validation, one may define m as the least integer >=ceil(U_JY(n)) satisfying B_JY(n,m)<=epsilon/2 and M=exp(m). No M value is calculated here.

simple_domination_cross_check_family.optimizer_guard: The denominator is D, not 2D: 3.03 already equals 2*1.515.
simple_domination_cross_check_family.rigorous_supremum: For D=0.8274-0.4=0.4274 and v=sqrt(u), the ratio is 9.39 v^3.03 exp(-Dv). Its unique global maximum occurs at v*=3.03/D, because d/dv log(v^3.03 exp(-Dv))=3.03/v-D. The maximum is 9.39[3.03/(eD)]^3.03=171.43357721989227<172.
